scenario: The ego vehicle is driving straight on a multi-lane city street when a white SUV swerves into its lane from the right, causing a side-impact collision.

ego.behavior: The car travels straight forward in its lane and is struck on its right side by a swerving SUV.

adversarials.behavior: The white SUV drives at high speed in the adjacent right lane, then swerves sharply left into the ego vehicle's lane to avoid another vehicle.
The car merges from the right side into the SUV's lane, prompting the SUV to swerve leftward.

spatial_relation: On a multi-lane city street with buildings and parked cars along both sides, the ego vehicle travels in the left lane while the white SUV is in the adjacent right lane; a third vehicle merges from the right into the SUV's lane.

road_side_structures.position: Positioned along the left side of the road, visible among the buildings and trees.

Enumeration: adversarials length is 2. 3. Chronology: initially ego drives straight with SUV approaching in right lane; midpoint SUV swerves left as third vehicle merges; ending collision occurs and SUV passes ahead. 4.
